text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is in the South Shetland Islands.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.
LocatedInTransitive(x, y, z) ::: if x is in y and y is in z, then x is in z.

Premises:
BarutinCove :::
Place(BarutinCove) ∧ NamedAfter(BarutinCove, BulgariaSettlement) ∧ LocatedIn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland) ∧ 
Place(SnowIsland) ∧ LocatedIn(SnowIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ∧ 
Place(GreenwichIsland) ∧ LocatedIn(GreenwichIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ∧ 
Place(DeceptionIsland) ∧ LocatedIn(DeceptionIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ∧ 
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ∧ Antarctica(x) ∧ LocatedIn(White(x), Antarctica) ∧
∀a ∀b ∀c ((LocatedIn(a, b) ∧ LocatedIn(b, c)) → LocatedIn(a, c)) ::: Transitivity of location.

Conclusion:
¬∃x (Island(x) ∧ NamedAfter(x, Antarctica) ∧ x ≠ BarutinCove) ::: Barutin Cove is not named after all islands in Antarctica.
